summary: Remote-driven PTY shell via WebSocket to conductor-ai.top
details: The daemon opens a WebSocket connection to wss://conductor.conductor-ai.top (overridable via CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_URL) and registers a handler that forwards incoming `terminal_input` payloads directly into a node-pty session on the installer's host. The PTY runs a configured coding CLI (claude/codex/opencode/kimi/copilot) or falls back to /bin/bash, /bin/zsh, or cmd.exe via resolveDefaultPtyShell, so any party authenticated to the backend can drive an interactive shell on the local machine. Additional behavior: `conductor config` can, as a last-resort fallback when no package manager is available and after an interactive Y/n prompt, execute `bash -lc 'curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash'` to install the opencode CLI from its official domain.
